title: Eddie Kingston vs. Jon Moxley: friendship under strain
summary: Old friends clash over the world championship before Kingston’s rescue of Moxley changes their relationship.

chapters.title: Kingston challenges his old friend
chapters.result: Moxley retains against Kingston by referee stoppage.
chapters.context: Kingston’s refusal to accept the finish keeps the dispute alive.

chapters.title: Kingston says I Quit
chapters.result: Moxley defeats Kingston in an I Quit title match.
chapters.context: The stipulation forces a conclusive answer to Kingston’s challenge.

chapters.title: Kingston runs back for Moxley
chapters.result: Kingston shields Moxley after the exploding barbed-wire match.
chapters.context: The attempted rescue becomes a turning point toward reconciliation.
